module.name: holoscan-tsdf
module.description: Dense 3D reconstruction on the GPU: depth images (uint16 millimeters or float32 meters), optionally with color, integrated into a fixed-size truncated signed distance volume from known camera poses; the volume ray cast into depth, normal and color images from any pose; and its surface extracted as an indexed triangle mesh with normals and colors by deterministic marching cubes into fixed-size outputs, on demand or every N frames. The volume can be reset and saved as a PLY mesh without a graph.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK, with memory for the volume: 8 bytes per voxel (12 with color), 128 MiB for 256^3.
